entities.summary: Hanson is an American pop rock band from Tulsa, Oklahoma, formed by brothers Isaac Hanson, Taylor Hanson, and Zac Hanson. Supporting members include Dimitrius Collins and Andrew Perusi (bass), who have toured and performed live with the band since 2007.
